# Transcribed Real Sports Highest-value boards

Operator screenshots from 2026-09-28, checked in so replay can score them
without a mounted Corpus C volume. `player_id` values are transcription keys,
not provider ids. `value` is the left-hand realized number. `displayed_value`
is the UI Value column. `drafts` is recorded and is not a training label.

The WNBA file is the same scoring law as an illustration. It is not a
wnba-oracle contest and it is not an NFL label.
